[b]Install Instructions[/b]
1. Unzip the file named "(CP) Geto Npc" (I use 7-zip)
2. copy that to your mod folder located "C:\Program Files
(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" (assuming you're using
steam)
3. done!
